title: PresentationDeck
description: Presentation content consisting of ordered slides referencing reusable slide layouts.

slides.description: Ordered slides making up the deck.

slide.description: A single slide referencing a reusable layout and carrying its content blocks.

id.description: Optional stable identifier for the slide.

layout.description: ID of a reusable slide layout.

title.description: Slide title. Optional so a divider or full-bleed slide can omit one. When present it binds to the reserved region id 'title' on the slide's layout; a missing region is an authoring error.

subtitle.description: Optional slide subtitle. When present it binds to the reserved region id 'subtitle' on the slide's layout; a missing region is an authoring error.

content.description: Content blocks placed into the slide's layout regions.

notes.description: Speaker notes or agent instructions specific to this slide.

hidden.description: When true, the slide is excluded from the rendered deck.

contentBlock.description: A single piece of slide content placed into a named layout region.

region.description: Layout region that receives this content. Must not be a reserved region id ('title', 'subtitle'), which are filled by the slide's own title and subtitle.

type.description: Content block kind. Each arm has a payload capable of expressing it and a renderer capable of drawing it, except 'mermaid': a schema-only nucleation point that stores diagram source with no renderer yet (see 'mermaidSource').

runs.description: Inline emphasis runs for a 'text' block that needs mixed formatting. When present the renderer uses these instead of the flat 'text' string.

bulletLevels.description: Optional indent level per entry in 'items', 0 (outermost) to 4. Shorter than 'items' leaves the remaining bullets at level 0.

value.description: Pre-formatted headline value for a 'metric' block, e.g. '$4.2M' or '+12%'. A string so number formatting and locale stay a renderer concern.

label.description: Caption naming what a 'metric' block measures.

delta.description: Optional change indicator for a 'metric' block, e.g. '+3.1pp QoQ'. Empty when the metric shows no comparison.

headers.description: Optional column headers for a 'table' block. Empty for a headerless table.

rows.description: Row-major cells for a 'table' block. Every cell is a pre-formatted string; ragged rows are an authoring error the consumer reports.

chartKind.description: Chart kind for a 'chart' block. Placeholder set; an arm is added only once it is renderable downstream.

categories.description: Shared x-axis category labels for a 'chart' block.

series.description: One or more named data series for a 'chart' block.

mermaidSource.description: Raw Mermaid diagram source text for a 'mermaid' block. This repository stores the source only; it does not parse, lay out, or render Mermaid diagrams. Rendering, if ever added, is a downstream (clerical-tools) concern.

source.description: Filesystem path to the image file for an 'image' block.

style.description: Optional style overrides for this content block.

textRun.description: A run of body text with uniform inline emphasis.

chartSeries.description: A named series of numeric values aligned to the chart's categories.

color.description: Optional semantic series color resolved from PresentationColorTheme.
